messages:
anya: quick check on the pool picker mock i uploaded. link: https://figma.com/file/mini2

jess: main problem is scan time. proposal: add a 3-item quick strip of "most used" pools at top. reduces clicks.

mike: backend can add preferredPools field. small API change. we'll emit ui.pool.quickpick.select events.

jess: selected pool chip should surface an SLO label (e.g., 'Low-latency') instead of only a color so it's readable at a glance.

omar: accessibility note: SLO label must have aria-label and meet 4.5:1 contrast. don't rely on color alone to convey tier.

lee: copy about "Burst" keeps confusing customers. recommend "Burst capacity (time-limited)" + help tooltip linking billing.

khalid: slider needs keyboard fallback and aria-live announcements. e.g., "Latency target: Balanced. Cost: Medium." Keep announcements brief (<60 chars).

anya: clamp behavior: if Min > poolMax show inline validation and SR announcement: "Min adjusted to pool max: 4."

mike: note: some pool caps come from another service; client should cache caps ~120s to avoid extra calls.

jess: i'll iterate frames tonight with quick strip, SLO label, updated burst copy and keyboard help text. posting updates tomorrow.

anya: thanks all ":thumbsup:"
